Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning economic development by requiring performance audits of certain permit practices by the state auditor.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to economic development by requiring performanceaudits of certain permit practices by the state auditor; and adding anew section to chapter 43.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state auditor's office must: (1) By September 30, 2013, complete a performance audit of arepresentative sample of permit practices at the city and county level,considering the recommendations of section 1, chapter 231, Laws of 2007and such other factors as the state auditor deems appropriate, andforward the audit to the public works board, the community economicrevitalization board, and the appropriate standing committees of thelegislature; and (2) Beginning in 2015, biennially review the city, county, andagency reports prepared under section 1, chapter 231, Laws of 2007 andreport any findings and recommendations based on its review to the p. 1 SB 6373public works board, the community economic revitalization board, andthe appropriate standing committees of the legislature.
